senses.gloss:
जप् जप्, cl. 1. P. जपति, जजाप, जपिष्-
यति, अजपीत् and अजापीत्, जपितुम्, to utter
in a low voice or under-tone, to mutter, whisper,
repeat internally, talk to one's self; to mutter prayers
or incantations, whisper magical spells or charms;
to pray to any one in a low voice (e. g. शिवो जप्यते,
Śiva is addressed with muttered prayers); to invoke
or call upon in a low voice: Caus. जापयति, -यितुम्,
अजीजपत्: Desid. जिजपिषति: Intens. जञ्जप्यते,
जञ्जपीति; [cf. जल्प्.]

जप, अस्, आ, अम्, muttering, whispering, uttering
in a low voice [cf. कर्णे-जप]; (अस्), m. mutter-
[]
ing prayers, repeating in a murmuring tone passages
from scripture, charms, names of a deity, &c.; counting
silently the beads of a rosary, &c.; a muttered prayer
or spell; [cf. जाप.]
—जप-ता, f. the state of a
mutterer or of one who mutters prayers.
—जप-
परायण, अस्, आ, अम्, devoted to repetition of prayers,
engaged in muttering prayers.
—जप-माला, f. a
rosary used for counting muttered prayers.
—जप-
यज्ञ, अस्, m. muttering prayers as a religious rite or
sacrifice.
—जप-होम, अस्, m. a sacrifice which con-
sists in muttering prayers.

जपा जपा, f. the China rose, either the
flower or plant; [cf. जवा.]

जाप जाप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. जप्), muttering,
whispering, muttering prayers or telling beads, reciting
passages of the Vedas &c. inaudibly; a prayer uttered
in this manner; [cf. कर्ण-जाप.]
जपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, muttering prayers in a low tone.

जपन, अम्, n. the muttering or whispering of
prayers or spells.

जापन जापन, अम्, n. (a Prākṛt form for
यापन), declining, rejection, dissent; dismissing,
sending away; completing, finishing.

जपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be uttered in a low
voice, to be whispered, to be muttered or repeated
inaudibly, to be meditated on.
जपित, अस्, आ, अम्, muttered, whispered.

जपित्वा, ind. having muttered or repeated in a
low tone.

जपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, uttering prayers in a low voice,
muttering.

जापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of an adj. comp.) re-
citing in a low voice.
जप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be muttered or whispered.
जप्त्वा, ind. having muttered or repeated inaudibly.

जप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be repeated in an under-
tone, to be muttered or whispered; (अम्, अस्), n. m.
a prayer to be uttered in a low voice, a muttered
prayer; [cf. जाप्य, किञ्-जप्य, ध्यान-जप्य.]
—जप्येश्वर-तीर्थ (˚य-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a
Tīrtha.

जाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be muttered, to be repeated
in a low voice; (अम्), n. a prayer to be muttered
inaudibly, the muttering of prayers &c.
जप्यक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

जपिल जपिल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N.
of a place.

जापक, अस्, इका, अम्, muttering prayers, one who
mutters prayers; relating to a muttered prayer;
(अम्), n. a kind of fragrant wood; (a various reading
has जायक.)
